To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

long-tail SEO is a growing security problem, and cloud hosting platforms are increasingly being used to host doorway pages to poison long-tail keywords, and that such pages have been effective in achieving high rankings in search results.

1) we have found that long-tail SEO spammers are abusing cloud hosting services to create doorway pages that are designed to rank highly for long-tail keywords; 2) we have found evidence that such spammers are using a wide range of techniques to monetize the traffic generated by these doorway pages; and 3) we have found some evidence that spammers are able to circumvent the countermeasures put in place by the cloud hosting services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: (1) How is long-tail SEO implemented on the cloud hosting platforms?
the following questions: (i) How do cloud hosting services support the long-tail SEO attacks and what kind of abuse is being carried out by the long-tail keyword spammers on cloud hosting services?
characterizing the long-tail SEO abuse on cloud hosting services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cloud hosting platforms are being used for large scale long-tail SEO poisoning.
longtail keyword poisoning on cloud hosting is a serious problem and that cloud hosting providers need to be aware of it.
longtail SEO spam is not only a threat to web search but also to web hosting providers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cloud hosting platforms are being used for long-tail spamming.
long-tail SEO spammers are taking advantage of the low cost and high scalability of cloud web hosting platforms to carry out large-scale SEO spam campaigns.
cloud-based long-tails SEO spam is effective and difficult to detect.
The main takeaway from our work is that
long-tail SEO spammers have become more aggressive in their use of cloud web hosting platforms.
long-tail SEO spammers are actively abusing cloud hosting services to poison search engines.
cloud hosting platforms are being used for long-tail keyword spam.
